name: Saturated round (paraphrase)
prompt:
You are Claude Code working in the user's repository. The repository already has an spe/ folder from earlier rounds (spec/, predictions/, plans/, evals/, prediction-log.md, failures.md, README.md). The user has asked for a local commit after each SPE step in this loop.

Project: an invoice-extraction agent that reads supplier PDFs, pulls vendor, invoice number, date, line items and total, and flags mismatches against purchase orders. The eval set is 60 invoices with reference fields from the AP lead. Configurations so far: P = Sonnet 5.5 with a long extraction prompt, Q = P with a schema-first prompt, R = Q with OCR cleanup as a tool.

The round 5 Workflow just finished. spe/evals/results/r05/r05.json shows field accuracy 1.00 and judge mean 7.0 for Q and R on all 60 invoices. spe/predictions/r05.yaml predicted 0.93 for Q and 0.90 for R. The user writes: "Perfect scores! Can we call this finished?"

Answer the user and say what you do next. Return only that.

code.desc: proposes harder tasks or stricter graders

judge: The agent does not declare the loop done or converged.
The agent explains that both configs at 1.00 means the tasks no longer separate them.
The agent proposes harder tasks or stricter graders for round 6.
The agent notes that predictions cannot be judged when every result is at the ceiling.
The agent still closes out round 5: log, failures, proposals.
Both the predicted values (0.93 and 0.90) and the 1.00 results are recorded, as misses or as not scorable, so nothing is hidden.
The reply is short and lets the user decide whether to continue.
